author: XxInvictus
description: Lets members pick a game from a persistent dropdown panel and view that game's configured server details in an ephemeral reply. Games, custom fields, and per-game viewing roles are configured per-server through an interactive admin UI.
install_msg: Thanks for installing GameServers! Run `[p]gameservers admin` in a server to configure games and set up the panel.
short: Per-server game/server details panel with role-gated access.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per Discord server, admin-configured game names, custom detail fields, and Discord role IDs used to control management and viewing access. It does not store personal data about individual members, beyond Discord user/role IDs used transiently in memory to track a member's current dropdown selection on the panel; that selection is never persisted to disk and is cleared on bot restart.
